fato_historico: 1911: Orville Wright remains in the air for nine minutes and 45 seconds in a glider at Kill Devil Hills, North Carolina.
energia_do_dia: Today, your inner fire burns with the intensity of an aviation pioneer reaching new heights. Much like a glider dancing gracefully against the wind, you may find that patience and steady focus allow you to stay aloft longer than expected. It is a good time to consider how your persistence can turn simple dreams into soaring, lasting achievements.
frase_do_dia: Believe in your wings and trust the wind to carry your boldest dreams forward.
significado_numero: Represents the momentum and duration of your personal growth and inner expansion.
conselho: Keep your gaze steady on the horizon and let your natural courage guide you.
